# 2 Baruch Chapter 50 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Fourth Fast and Dialogue

---

**1** He answered me: "Listen, Baruch — write all of this in the memory of your heart.

**2** The earth will certainly give back the dead at that time. It receives them now to hold them, making no changes to their form.

**3** As it received them, so it will return them. As I gave them to it, so it will raise them.

**4** For at that time it will be necessary to show the living that the dead have come back to life — that those who had gone away have returned."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Prioritizes clarity and natural English flow while preserving the theological and narrative content of the Syriac source.*
